# Introduction

The **`diagnosticmeta`** analysis (Diagnostic Test Meta-Analysis for Pathology) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Comprehensive meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy studies designed for pathology research. Performs bivariate random-effects modeling, proportional-hazards SROC analysis, meta-regression, and publication bias assessment for AI algorithm validation and biomarker diagnostic accuracy synthesis.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("diagnosticmeta_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::diagnosticmeta(
#   data = diagnosticmeta_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `diagnosticmeta` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
